footnote_text: Represents shares of the Issuer's common stock (the "Shares") sold to cover tax withholding obligations in connection with the exercise of the Reporting Person's non-qualified stock option into Shares. || The price reported reflects a weighted average price of the Shares. The Shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $18.99 to $19.03 per Share. The Reporting Person will provide to the Issuer, any security holder of the Issuer or the Securities Exchange Commission staff, upon request, information regarding the number of Shares sold at each price within the range.
The reporting person exercised the non-qualified stock option due to its upcoming expiration date.
